evidence.text: What constraints on leading higher-derivative scalar, Maxwell, and Einstein-Maxwell interactions follow from probe time delays on infinitely boosted Coulomb-like or Reissner-Nordström backgrounds, and what causal interpretation survives the gravitational logarithm in four dimensions?

sources.title: Causality Violation, Gravitational Shockwaves and UV Completion

evidence.text: Solve the photon initial-value problem using the retarded vacuum-polarization tensor, scalar proper-time propagators, and an eikonal resummation into the phase. The formalism is imported from the authors' earlier work and applied here to shockwaves.

sources.title: Causality in curved spacetimes: The speed of light and gravity

evidence.text: Subtracted Källén–Lehmann representations for exchange between conserved sources relate positive spin-0 and spin-2 spectral densities to the direction of curvature-coefficient flow.

sources.title: Gravitational causality and the self-stress of photons

evidence.text: Construct form-factor discontinuities above charged-pair threshold using Cutkosky cuts of tree amplitudes, massive spinor-helicity variables and an auxiliary photon-to-spectator amplitude. Recover form factors by dispersion relations, subtracting F1 according to its zero-transfer normalization.

sources.title: Electric shocks: bounding Einstein-Maxwell theory with time delays on boosted RN backgrounds

evidence.text: Write black-hole metrics in isotropic coordinates, boost along x, and take the distributional ultrarelativistic limit. Finite-energy scaling uses m = m0/γ and q² = q0²/γ, with the analogous magnetic scaling. Gauge fields vanish in this limit, but contracted quantities can survive; probe equations must be formed before taking the limit.

sources.title: Causality bounds from charged shockwaves in 5d

evidence.text: Linearize the photon equations and use a Lorenz-gauge ansatz with transverse harmonic components. Polarization one is perpendicular to the impact parameter, while polarization two is parallel; the transverse family shares one delay independently of its free polarization parameters.

sources.title: Shockwaves and time delays in Einstein-Maxwell effective field theory

evidence.text: Use Bianchi identities, integration by parts, leading equations of motion and the four-dimensional Gauss–Bonnet identity to organize redundancies. For probe backreaction, perturb both Maxwell and Einstein equations and exploit the O5 metric field redefinition.

sources.title: Causality in Nonlocal Gravity

evidence.text: Do selected weakly nonlocal gravitational theories produce a negative Shapiro time delay in weakly coupled high-energy scattering, and can a field-redefinition construction generate matter-coupled theories that pass this causality test?

sources.title: Phenomenological description of quantum gravity inspired modified classical electrodynamics

evidence.text: How can a broad class of quantum-gravity-motivated corrections to classical electrodynamics be described phenomenologically, and what do they imply for electromagnetic propagation, energy transport, birefringence, and cutoff-related causality?

sources.title: About apparent superluminal drives in generic gravity theories

evidence.text: Can the Gao–Wald compact-set time-delay conclusion be extended beyond GR and its null energy/generic conditions through a Raychaudhuri-based continuity argument for conjugate points, and what causal applications follow?

sources.title: Loop quantum gravity corrections to gravitational wave dispersion

evidence.text: How do quantum corrections to gravitational and electromagnetic Hamiltonians change their wave speeds, and can those changes preserve a shared causal cone? A second question asks whether tensor stability and constraint closure constrain the evolution of a discrete quantum-geometric state.

sources.title: Ultimate physical limits to computation

evidence.text: What upper limits do quantum mechanics, thermodynamics, relativity, and gravity place on computation speed, memory, and serial versus parallel operation? The benchmark is an ideal one-kilogram computer occupying one liter.

sources.title: Ultimate physical limits to computation

evidence.text: The thermodynamic discussion reviews Landauer and Bennett: reversible computation need not dissipate in principle, whereas erasing information exports entropy of at least k_B ln2 per lost bit. Error correction is analyzed through this export cost and outgoing radiation capacity.

sources.title: Ultimate physical limits to computation

evidence.text: The speed argument imports quantum orthogonalization-time bounds, illustrates saturation with a two-level NOT gate, embeds Boolean logic reversibly through Toffoli gates, and sums the rates of gates sharing a total energy budget.

sources.title: Ultimate physical limits to computation

evidence.text: Memory is estimated by maximizing canonical-ensemble entropy at fixed average energy and volume. Relativistic particle modes contribute through species and polarization counts; a photon black-body calculation supplies a lower estimate for the maximum entropy.

sources.title: Limits to Computational Acceleration Imposed by Quantum Field Theory and Quantum Gravity

evidence.text: Can relativistic time dilation, Malament–Hogarth geometries, or exotic memory fields enable hypercomputation, and what quantum effects constrain the achievable runtime and memory compression?

sources.title: Quantum gravity and minimum length

evidence.text: Do distinct quantum-gravity arguments suggest a fundamental limit to position and time resolution, and what would such a limit imply for ultraviolet behavior, measurement, causality and classical spacetime?

sources.title: Quantum astrometric observables I: time delay in classical and quantum gravity

evidence.text: Can operationally defined clock comparisons furnish explicit diffeomorphism-invariant gravitational observables, probe classical causal structure, and test whether analogous causal inequalities survive quantization?

systems: Periodic scalars and localized nonperturbative events
targets: Possible phenomenological implications of quantum-gravity consistency
assumptions: Quantum-gravity consistency proposals retain their source-specific evidential status
The white paper explicitly does not guarantee solutions to the listed phenomenological problems
conventions: Allowing some symmetric couplings differs from requiring every allowed coupling to be symmetric
A causal arrow is not identified with time-reversal invariance of a coupling
includes: Ordinary EFT mechanisms with no required Swampland premise
excludes: Automatic classification as a causal-propagation constraint
Treating a pre-backreaction setting as a derived gravitational bound

sources.title: Inflating with Large Effective Fields

evidence.text: Compute canonical single-field slow-roll observables from potential derivatives. Appendix A discusses covariant target-space derivatives and trajectory proper distance to formulate slow roll and large excursions independently of field coordinates.

sources.title: Euclidean wormholes, baby universes, and their impact on particle physics and cosmology

evidence.text: Derive the reparametrization constraint, reinterpret its solution as a field, and introduce interactions representing topology change. This supplies a dynamical alternative to simply integrating static α parameters.

sources.title: Theta-problem and the String Swampland

evidence.text: Choose a symplectic three-cycle basis, evaluate both holomorphic three-form periods, and form their negative ratio. The basis fixes the electric/magnetic frame; evaluating j removes that frame dependence.

sources.title: Approximate Symmetries and Gravity

evidence.text: Semiclassical two-body collision estimates, radiation-fluctuation entropy and nonrelativistic Poisson statistics feed Boltzmann estimates of black-hole formation and equilibration.

sources.title: Inflating with Large Effective Fields

evidence.text: Construct invariant coset metrics and symmetry-breaking potentials using chiral-perturbation methods. Timelike, spacelike or null SO(2,1) order parameters provide different potential shapes in the noncompact example.

sources.title: Inflating with Large Effective Fields

evidence.text: Dimensionally reduce the higher-dimensional Einstein action and transform to Einstein frame. The radius obeys ρ ∝ exp(λφ/Mp), with λ^2 = 2/[n(n + 2)]; inverse-radius curvature expansions consequently become exponential potentials for the canonical scalar.
